disclaimer: Briefings are planning lists. Airlines, banks and missions change rules. Confirm tickets, insurance and registration deadlines on official pages.

items.title: National visa sticker / entry window
items.tip: Enter in the validity on the sticker. City registration (Anmeldung) after arrival.

items.title: Blocked account / first funds
items.tip: Know how to unblock after Anmeldung. Carry some cash + a working card.

items.title: Health insurance certificate
items.tip: Public or travel-to-public handover as your uni/employer specified.

items.title: Housing proof for week one
items.tip: Hostel/Airbnb is fine for arrival; long-term contract comes after Anmeldung.

items.title: Degree originals + translations
items.tip: Some Ausländerbehörde / uni offices still want paper.

items.title: German SIM and bank appointment plan
items.tip: Book bank after address registration. Don’t expect same-day Girokonto.

items.title: University / Berufsschule enrolment letters
items.tip: Print digital letters. Know the orientation week address.

items.title: eVisa / BRP successor status
items.tip: Create or check the UKVI account before you fly. Screenshot status.

items.title: CAS and tuberculosis certificate copies
items.tip: Airline and border may not ask — keep PDFs offline anyway.

items.title: Maintenance funds access
items.tip: You may need to show you can still pay. Don’t empty the account the day after visa.

items.title: NHS surcharge is already paid with the visa
items.tip: Register with a GP after you have an address.

items.title: Airport to campus plan
items.tip: National Express / train booked. Night arrivals need a hotel buffer.

items.title: Police registration if your visa says so
items.tip: Only if the vignette/conditions require it.

items.title: Residence permit card appointment
items.tip: Visa sticker is not the whole stay. Book the immigration client gate as instructed.

items.title: Address / dorm letter
items.tip: Needed for the card. Keep the landlord’s ID copy if private rent.

items.title: Health insurance valid on day 1
items.tip: Travel policy until student insurance activates.

items.title: Tuition receipt
items.tip: Some border/immigration checks still ask.

items.title: EUR cash for first week
items.tip: Cards work in Budapest; smaller towns less so.

items.title: National visa vs karta pobytu path
items.tip: Know whether you convert in-country and the voivodeship office city.

items.title: PESEL / address registration
items.tip: Landlord cooperation matters. Unis often brief this in week one.

items.title: Insurance and student ID
items.tip: Legitymacja unlocks fares. Carry passport until then.

items.title: Winter clothing if arriving Oct–Feb
items.tip: Pakistan-to-Poland is a climate shock — pack a coat in hold luggage.

items.title: Permesso di soggiorno kit within 8 days
items.tip: Post office kit after arrival — missing this is a common disaster.

items.title: Codice fiscale
items.tip: Needed for rent, phone, bank. Uni international office usually helps.

items.title: DSU / canteen card if awarded
items.tip: Bring income papers that match the regional demand.

items.title: Housing contract for the permesso
items.tip: Hotel bookings are a short bridge only.

items.title: Port of entry letter and study permit
items.tip: The sticker/letter is not always the final permit — answer border questions consistently.

items.title: GIC / first funds access
items.tip: Know which bank and how long activation takes.

items.title: DLI enrolment and orientation
items.tip: You must start the programme you were approved for.

items.title: SIN after arrival if you will work
items.tip: Only if your permit allows work. Rules change — verify IRCC.

items.title: Winter kit for most cities
items.tip: Buy a proper coat in Canada if luggage is tight — budget for it.

items.title: IRP appointment / registration
items.tip: Book early — Dublin slots can lag. Stamp conditions on the IRP.

items.title: Private health insurance
items.tip: Often required for registration. Carry the policy PDF.

items.title: PPS number after you have an address
items.tip: Needed for work and some banking.

items.title: Tuition balance plan
items.tip: Some unis want a large first instalment before the IRP.

items.title: Passport valid well beyond arrival
items.tip: Missions often want 6–12 months. Carry a colour copy separately from the original.

items.title: Offer, visa, insurance, tickets — offline copies
items.tip: Phone battery dies. Print a thin folder.

items.title: Prescription medicines in original boxes
items.tip: Plus a doctor letter. Check the destination’s controlled-drug list.

items.title: Emergency contacts + SK WhatsApp
items.tip: +92 304 5999859 — we do not control borders, but we can talk you through documents.

items.title: No undeclared work plans
items.tip: Student and visit visas have hour and purpose limits. Border officers ask.
